new_rows.claim: Bracket resolvers are pluggable via `src/resolver.zig` — a `Resolver` takes a `ResolveContext` (colex, side, L, H) and returns `Resolution.value` or `.no_opinion`. No resolver is authoritative; output is never promoted without independent agreement (ADR-0022).

new_rows.claim: The capture budget is demoted from a ruleset candidate to a named, pluggable resolver (`capture_budget(B)`) whose registration metadata records its measured non-convergence: 4x3 root oscillates forever in {0,1,2,7,9,12}, never equals PSK truth +4; internal consistency is not external agreement (ADR-0022 §Context). MIGOS +2 is the same class of precedent (T274, T290).

The resolver comparison harness includes two controls: (1) null — the `none` resolver proposes nothing and moves no counter; (2) seeded — `deliberately_wrong` (propose L-1) is immediately REFUTED by the L==H agreement column. Both fire correctly at 3x3 (23,420 positions). The capture_budget(B) resolver is a documented partial implementation: proposes L for L==H entries (the budget rule preserves the determined region at sufficient B per T387; 0/21,126 moved at 3x3 B≥24), no_opinion for L<H (requires full forward search with the game engine — not computable from [L,H] alone). This replaces the original always-no_opinion stub, making the comparison measurable where it was previously 0/0.
